channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Puerto Rico's defense-manufacturing niche kept delivering: Pentaq Manufacturing's Sabana Grande expansion (50 jobs) is part of roughly $119M in Pentagon textile contracts to island firms, alongside a $45M Army microgrid contract at Fort Buchanan, Abbott's $3.2M Arecibo device expansion, $33M+ in institutional tax-equity financing for a Yabucoa solar project, continued FEMA disaster-recovery capital, and a $122M San Juan bond issuance that earned investment-grade ratings. Real risks persist: recurring LUMA/Costa Sur blackouts hit nearly 200,000 customers twice this period, a severe drought forced water rationing in the San Juan metro, and utilities publicly told legislators they cannot yet supply water or power to the $2 billion Esencia project the Governor promoted on Wall Street.
